params.text_content:
📖 **Hermes Commands**

`/start` -- Acknowledge platform start pings without a reply
`/new [name]` -- Start a new session (fresh session ID + history) (alias: `/reset`)
`/topic [off|help|session-id]` -- Enable or inspect Telegram DM topic sessions
`/save <json|md|html> [filename] [redact]` -- Export the current conversation (bare /save shows usage)
`/retry` -- Retry the last message (resend to agent)
`/undo [N]` -- Back up N user turns and re-prompt (default 1)
`/title [name]` -- Set a title for the current session
`/branch [--here] [name]` -- Branch the current session (new thread on Discord/Telegram/Slack/Matrix; --here stays here) (alias: `/fork`)
`/compress [here [N] | focus topic | --preview|--dry-run]` -- Compress conversation context (add 'here [N]' to keep recent N turns; --preview shows what would happen) (alias: `/compact`)
`/rollback [number] [--all]` -- List or restore filesystem checkpoints (restores keep your hand-edits; --all overrides)
`/stop` -- Kill all running background processes
`/discard` -- Drop a turn lost when Hermes restarted so this chat's queue runs again
`/pause [reason | off]` -- Pause new work globally (emergency stop); '/pause off' resumes
`/approve [session|always]` -- Approve a pending dangerous command
`/deny [all] [reason]` -- Deny a pending dangerous command (optionally with a reason)
`/bg <prompt>` -- Run a prompt in a separate background session
`/btw <question>` -- Ask a side question about the current conversation without interrupting it
`/agents` -- Show active agents and running tasks (alias: `/tasks`)
`/queue [<prompt>|list|edit N <prompt>|rm N|move A B|clear]` -- Queue a prompt for the next turn, or list/edit/rm/move/clear queued prompts (alias: `/q`)
`/steer <prompt>` -- Inject a message after the next tool call without interrupting (alias: `/s`)
`/goal [text | -- <text> | draft <text> | show | gate add <cmd> | pause | resume | clear | status | wait <pid> | unwait]` -- Set a standing goal Hermes works on across turns until achieved
`/heartbeat [every <interval> <prompt> | status | pause | resume | clear]` -- Set a recurring prompt that re-enters this session when idle (alias: `/hb`)
`/refine [focus instructions]` -- Review this conversation now and save lessons to memory/skills
`/review [review instructions]` -- Spawn an independent subagent to review the work just discussed (PR, code, docs)
`/loop [interval] <prompt> [--times N] [--until <condition>] | status | pause | resume | stop` -- Re-run a prompt on a recurring interval in this session (alias: `/proactive`)
`/plan [task]` -- Write a markdown implementation plan to .hermes/plans/ without executing anything
`/moa <prompt>` -- Run one prompt through the default Mixture of Agents preset, then restore your model
`/subgoal [text | remove N | clear]` -- Add or manage extra criteria on the active goal
`/status` -- Show session, model, token, and context info
`/egress [status]` -- Show Docker egress proxy status
`/context [all]` -- Show detailed context window view with usage gauge, category breakdown, compression stats, and throughput (alias: `/ctx`)
`/whoami` -- Show your slash command access (admin / user)
`/profile` -- Show active profile name and home directory
`/sethome` -- Set this chat as the home channel (alias: `/set-home`)
`/resume [name]` -- Resume a previously-named session
`/sessions` -- Browse and resume previous sessions
`/model [model|reset] [--provider name] [--reasoning level] [--global|--session] [--refresh]` -- Switch model (session-scoped; --global to persist)
`/codex-runtime [auto|codex_app_server]` -- Toggle codex app-server runtime for OpenAI/Codex models
`/personality [name]` -- Set a predefined personality
`/diff [staged|all|session] [--stat] [path...]` -- Show git changes in the working directory
`/footer [on|off|status]` -- Toggle gateway runtime-metadata footer on final replies
`/yolo` -- Toggle YOLO mode (skip all dangerous command approvals)
`/approvals [manual|smart|off]` -- Show or set the persistent dangerous-command approval mode
`/reasoning [level|show|hide|full|clamp] [--global]` -- Manage reasoning effort and display
`/fast [normal|fast|auto|cold|ultrafast|status] [--global]` -- Fast mode — OpenAI Priority Processing / Anthropic Fast Mode (normal/fast/auto/cold/ultrafast)
`/voice [on|off|tts|status]` -- Toggle voice mode
`/busy [queue|steer|interrupt|status]` -- Control how messages behave while Hermes is working
`/autoprune [on|off|later|status]` -- Turn automatic pruning of old sessions on or off
`/memory [pending|approve|reject|approval] [id|on|off]` -- Review pending memory writes / toggle the approval gate
`/bundles` -- List skill bundles (aliases /<name> for multiple skills)
`/learn <what to learn from>` -- Learn a reusable skill from anything you describe (dirs, URLs, this chat, notes)
`/init [notes]` -- Generate or update AGENTS.md project instructions from a repo scan
`/suggestions [accept|dismiss N | catalog]` -- Review suggested automations (accept/dismiss) (alias: `/suggest`)
`/blueprint [name] [slot=value ...]` -- Set up an automation from a blueprint template (alias: `/bp`)
`/curator [subcommand]` -- Background skill maintenance (status, run, pin, archive, list-archived)
`/kanban [subcommand]` -- Multi-profile collaboration board (tasks, links, comments)
`/reload-mcp` -- Reload MCP servers from config
`/reload-skills` -- Re-scan ~/.hermes/skills/ for newly installed or removed skills
`/commands [page]` -- Browse all commands and skills (paginated)
`/help [skills|<filter>]` -- Show available commands (/help skills lists skill commands, /help <text> filters)
`/restart` -- Gracefully restart the gateway after draining active runs
`/usage [reset [--force]]` -- Show token usage and rate limits; `reset` redeems a banked Codex limit reset
`/login` -- Sign in with a Nous account (keeps your connectors)
`/topup` -- Show your Nous balance and manage billing on the portal
`/insights [days]` -- Show usage insights and analytics
`/platform <pause|resume|list> [name]` -- Pause, resume, or list a failing gateway platform
`/update` -- Update Hermes Agent to the latest version
`/version` -- Show Hermes Agent version (alias: `/v`)
`/debug [upload|nous upload|local]` -- Debug report (versions, config keys, error counts; no log text): shows the privacy notice; /debug upload shares links

⚡ **Skill Commands** (39 active):
`/architecture-diagram` — Dark-themed SVG architecture/cloud/infra diagrams as HTML.
`/arxiv` — Search arXiv papers by keyword, author, category, or ID.
`/ascii-video` — ASCII video: convert video/audio to colored ASCII MP4/GIF.
`/baoyu-infographic` — Infographics: 21 layouts x 21 styles (信息图, 可视化).
`/blocked-page-recovery` — Use when a fetch fails: 403/429, paywall, WAF, bot wall.
`/claude-code` — Delegate coding to Claude Code CLI (features, PRs).
`/claude-design` — Design one-off HTML artifacts (landing, deck, prototype).
`/codebase-inspection` — Inspect codebases w/ pygount: LOC, languages, ratios.
`/codex` — Delegate coding to OpenAI Codex CLI (features, PRs).
`/competitor-news-monitor` — Watch named companies for material news; cited digests.

... and 29 more. Use `/commands` for the full paginated list.
